newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finland hails EU Estonia move, wants more Balts.
newsitem.headline: Finland hails EU Estonia move, wants more Balts.

text.p: Finland, a member of the European Union since 1995 and Estonia's nearest EU neighbour, on Wednesday welcomed a plan to invite Estonia to join membership talks and said it hoped other Baltics would follow soon.
"Finland is pleased that the Commission has found that Estonia meets the membership criteria so that membership talks can begin," the foreign ministry said in a statement.

"Finland hopes that the rapid economic and social development of Latvia and Lithuania will also enable negotiations to be started in the near future," it added, repeating that it supports enlargement in general.
The European Commission officially unveiled plans to embrace Estonia and four other members of the former Communist bloc.
It said also Poland, Hungary, the Czech Republic and Slovenia should be invited to begin EU membership talks along with Cyprus next year.
